title: A Hard Look at SPAC Projections

rival_explanations: the projection pattern reflects general firm attributes rather than the SPAC merger-marketing setting

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (SPAC mergers / firms going public via a special purpose acquisition company merger, spanning sectors)
context.sample_description: SPACs that completed an IPO and announced a merger target during the de-SPAC process, compiled from spactrack.net and spacalpha.com plus S-1 filings from the SEC's EDGAR database (blank check / special purpose acquisition company, SIC 6770); removing firms still seeking a merger target, liquidated, foreign-filing, or that had not publicly filed their road show presentation
context.sample_size: 389 SPACs (main sample; 212 with no missing data)

data_sources.name: Compustat (universe of the United States since 2004)
Factiva (company press releases, hand collected for postmerger guidance)

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: 389 SPACs that announced a merger target (310 with projections)

dv.name: projection metrics and time horizon
dv.measure: whether transactions include projections, which financial metrics they project (revenue, EBITDA, gross profit, capex, free cash flow, net income, other), and average projection length in years
dv.source: Hand-collected from SEC filings and road show presentations

analyses.label: Table 4 - Revenue Projection Attributes: Time Horizon (by SPAC merger announcement year)

dv.name: revenue projection horizon
dv.measure: frequency and horizon (0-6+ years) of revenue projections by year of SPAC merger announcement
dv.source: Hand-collected from SEC filings and road show presentations

analyses.label: Table 5 Panels A-B - Forecast accuracy by forecast horizon

dv.name: revenue forecast accuracy
dv.measure: proportion of firms that met their forecast; mean and median scaled forecast errors; and cumulative sales realizations relative to cumulative projections
dv.source: Hand-collected projections vs actual postmerger revenue (Compustat / firm filings)

key_ivs.name: forecast horizon
key_ivs.measure: forecast horizon (one-, two-, three-, four-year forecasts)

analyses.label: Table 5 Panels C-D - Forecast accuracy by sponsor type (serial vs non-serial)
analyses.sample: subset of SPACs with observable revenue outcomes

dv.name: revenue forecast accuracy
dv.source: Hand-collected projections vs actual postmerger revenue

analyses.label: Table 6 - Comparison of SPAC and benchmark firm characteristics
analyses.sample: SPACs vs U.S. IPO firms and 1:1 propensity-score matched public firms

dv.name: firm characteristics
dv.measure: average assets, revenues, ROA, profitable, life cycle, tech, and leverage

key_ivs.name: SPAC vs benchmark group (IPO firms and matched sample)
key_ivs.measure: indicator for SPAC target vs benchmark firms (all U.S. industrial firms completing an original IPO during the sample period; and a 1:1 propensity-score matched sample)

analyses.label: Table 7 / Figures 1-2 - SPAC projected revenue growth vs benchmark actual revenue growth

dv.name: revenue growth rate
dv.source: Hand-collected SPAC forecasted revenue; actual revenue from Compustat for benchmark firms

key_ivs.name: SPAC projection vs benchmark actual (IPO and matched samples)
key_ivs.measure: difference between average/median SPAC projected revenue growth and actual revenue growth of IPO firms and matched public firms over the forecast horizon

analyses.label: Table 8 - Projection persistence: de-SPAC process vs following the merger
analyses.sample: SPACs that completed a merger before 2021 (allowing at least six months to provide guidance)

dv.name: projection provision and horizon
dv.measure: proportion of firms that provide some type of financial projection and average projection horizon, during the de-SPAC process versus following the merger
dv.source: Hand-collected from SEC filings (de-SPAC) and company press releases in Factiva (postmerger)

key_ivs.name: timing (de-SPAC process vs postmerger)
key_ivs.measure: indicator for during de-SPAC process versus following merger completion

analyses.label: Table 9 - SPAC vs benchmark postmerger guidance
analyses.sample: SPACs completing a merger before 2021 vs stratified random subsample of IPO firms and matched public firms

dv.name: postmerger guidance provision and horizon
dv.measure: proportion of firms providing postmerger projections and average guidance horizon (years)
dv.source: Hand-collected from company press releases in Factiva; Compustat for benchmark firm identification

key_ivs.name: SPAC vs benchmark group
key_ivs.measure: indicator for SPAC firms vs stratified random subsample of IPO firms (same number of firms per year) and matched sample of public firms
